title: How Fast Can a World Cup Goal Be Scored?

lines.text: How fast can a World Cup goal be scored?
In 2002, Turkey played Korea Republic in the third-place match, in Daegu.
Guinness World Records lists it as the fastest World Cup goal, as recognised by FIFA.
So on record, the answer is eleven seconds.
Subscribe for the next football number.

description: Eleven seconds. Hakan Şükür's goal for Turkey against Korea Republic in the 2002 third-place match in Daegu is listed by Guinness World Records as the fastest World Cup goal, as recognised by FIFA.
